title: Uka Promesa de la Umbral ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
intro: Divino ukar katuyat chuyman amuktʼat cuartonakapanjja, mä qollan juramentow amuytʼasïna. Uka arsüwix janïr samañjam jakañ tuqitwa parläna, ukat phuqasitapax ajay tuqit herencian saräwip wiñayatakiw mayjtʼayaspa. Mä alman misteriopar mantañamawa, uka alman arsutapax wiñayatakiw ist’asïna.
clues: Diosar yupaychañ tuqit uñtʼat utanwa jakasiyäta, ukat mä regalo katuqañ wal munta, uka regalox Diosar jukʼamp jakʼachasiñapatakiw yanaptʼitäna.
Nayax Tatitujampiw mä jach’a arust’äwi lurawayta kunatix nayan manqhan imantatäki uka tuqita, Jupar luqtañatakiw taqpach arust’asta.
Kunapachatï uñachtʼayañ horasajj purinkäna ukhajja, kuntï katoqkayäta ukajj janiw suykayätti, ukampis Taqe Yatirinakaruw uka toqet katuyayäta.
Wawajarojj Diosar yupaychañ uñachtʼayir mä suti churta, ukat maldecit wawat jarkʼaqatäñapatakiw achiktʼasiyäta.
Wawajarojj qollan santuarioruw uchatäpjjäna, Aaronan familiapat jutir mä profetan uñjata.
Phuchajajj qʼoma sarnaqatapat uñtʼatäjjänwa, ukat taqe warminakat sipansa ajllitäjjänwa, qhepatjja mä jachʼa profetan taykapänwa, ukampis jan llamktʼatäkchïnsa.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
